title: FREE World Update 23 + huge new airports! | MSFS 2024 marketplace breakdown
description:
If you're looking to expand your virtual flight log across international airline gateways, backcountry grass strips, and updated photogrammetry cities, the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace just rolled out a massive wave of scenery and visual overhauls! Headlining this week's drop is the brand-new, completely FREE World Update 23: Poland and the Baltics, bringing overhauled digital elevation models, photogrammetry cities, and handcrafted regional airfields. Alongside this massive first-party expansion, third-party developers have delivered high-altitude international hubs, scenic coastal airfields, interactive wilderness lodges, and detailed city skylines.

In this scenery breakdown, we inspect the latest airfield arrivals, visual quality, terminal modeling, and dependencies to help you decide what deserves space on your virtual drive:

🌍 FREE FIRST-PARTY REGIONAL OVERHAULS
We open with World Update 23: Poland and the Baltics (Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, and Poland). We inspect the updated photogrammetry across major cities like Warsaw, Krakow, Riga, and Tallinn, improved triangulated irregular networks (TIN), digital elevation models, and custom points of interest. Plus, we highlight the 5 newly included handcrafted airfields: including Kärdla (EEKA), Jūrmala (EVJA), Palanga (EYPA), Warsaw-Babice (EPBC), and Opole-Kamień Śląski (EPKN), alongside new landing challenges and discovery flights.

✈️ INTERNATIONAL FLAGSHIP HUBS & COMMERCIAL GATEWAYS
- Addis Ababa Bole International Airport (HAAB) by iniBuilds: Ethiopia's bustling capital gateway and the high-altitude home base of Ethiopian Airlines (elev. 7,600+ ft), rendered with custom terminal interiors, apron signage, and heavy long-haul ramp operations.
- Santa Barbara Municipal Airport (KSBA) by Gaya Simulations: California coastal flying at its finest, complete with distinctive Spanish-style architecture, 3D passenger terminal interiors, custom boarding bridges, and mixed airline/GA aprons.
- Islas Malvinas Rosario International Airport (SAAR) by Vo Simple: Santa Fe, Argentina's key gateway featuring 3D terminal modeling, custom hangars, and dynamic night lighting.
- Hotan / Xitang Airport (ZWTN) by MSFSceneryBuilders: A detailed regional field in China with customized aprons, taxiways, and terminal additions.

🛩️ GENERAL AVIATION, RELIEVERS & WILDERNESS LODGES
- Sky Country Lodge (AL60) by Hangar Studios 713: An interactive backcountry grass strip complete with an exploratory lodge, tablet-controlled hangar doors and lighting, campfire events, pre-programmed night fireworks, and your personal guide dog, Hoodie!
- Leicester Airport (EGBG) by Burning Blue Design: Classic English countryside aviation steeped in RAF heritage, featuring 140+ custom 3D models, detailed control tower interior, animated spectators, and an adjacent go-kart track.
- Lorain County Regional Airport (KLPR) by UK2000 Scenery: Northern Ohio's premier corporate and training reliever, complete with a modeled Cirrus Aircraft service center and spawnable hangars (requires the free UK2000 Common Library).

🏙️ HANDCRAFTED SKYLINES & SAFARI LANDSCAPES
Looking to upgrade default urban horizons? SamScene3D brings four landmark expansions:
- Modern Cities: Denver, Minneapolis, and Indianapolis (handcrafted high-rises, stadiums, seasonal textures, and night illumination—requires the free USA World Update).
- Nairobi City & Safari: A dual package enhancing the skyline of Kenya's vibrant capital, paired with Wilson Airport (HKNW) and Keekorok Airstrip (HKKE) complete with animated safari wildlife.

Which of these new marketplace additions are you flying into first? Exploring the free photogrammetry in World Update 23, flying heavy long-haul legs into Addis Ababa, or touching down on the grass at Sky Country Lodge? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2024 scenery releases, don't forget to hit like, subscribe to the channel for weekly simulator coverage, and clear skies on your next departure!
